featured_reviews.name: Sloka Balasubramanyan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered bulk chocolates from Snackrack for giveaways at a family function. The quality of chocolates was excellent and they don't melt too soon so are best to store.

Rajshree, the owner personally engaged with us to share the options available and suggest combinations. Upon request, she had us sample a curated collection of the varieties on offer so that we could decide the ones we wanted to go with. Our order was quite large and included specific packing instructions for some boxes that had to shipped outside the city. She patiently understood our requirements and ensured they were met. Given the size of the order, she also made sure of timely completion of the order, well before time for our event.

We had specific requirements for the tins in which we wanted to pack the chocolates and she went out of her way to try and source them. We eventually went with an external vendor but would like to highlight her efforts in trying to get us what we wanted and specially making trips to Crawford market and liaising with her vendors to see what best is possible.

She was super responsive on WhatsApp and always available for any clarifications or to alleviate any concerns I had on the longevity and staying capacity of the chocolates!

Our final picks were milk chocolate almond rocks and white chocolate berry berry which were much appreciated by our family and friends. Have to add that all the chocolates were eggless and her entire menu is vegetarian.

Having tried the other samples and given her pleasing demeanour, would highly recommend her services.

She does a variety of cakes and desserts and comes up with very unique gifting solutions for all occasions - I have in the past dealt with her for diwali gifting as well. Definitely relying on her for a lot of our future requirements too!!

Do try out her cakes, bakes, sweets and treats!!
